feature.plugin_manager.description: Switch features on and off, install third-party plugins and order the sidebar apps.
feature.plugin_manager.name: Plugins
plugin_manager.col.author: Author
plugin_manager.confirm.remove_row: Remove {name} from the list? Its data stays in the database.
plugin_manager.confirm.restart: Restart the wiki? Pages being loaded right now may fail once.
plugin_manager.delete.body: The plugin's folder and its entry are deleted.
plugin_manager.delete.drop_hint: A copy of the database is saved first. Deleted tables can only come back from a backup.
plugin_manager.delete.intro: Removes the plugin's files and its entry. You choose on the next page whether its data goes too.
plugin_manager.delete.no_data: The plugin has no tables of its own.
plugin_manager.delete.still_loaded: Its code stays in memory until the next restart, with its pages already closed.
plugin_manager.delete.title: Delete this plugin
plugin_manager.disable_confirm.title: Disable {name}?
plugin_manager.enable_confirm.body: This plugin needs the following, which are not enabled:
plugin_manager.enable_confirm.title: Enable {name}?
plugin_manager.enable_external.backup: A copy of the database is saved in the instance folder (plugin_safety_snapshots) before the plugin is enabled.
plugin_manager.enable_external.body: Enabling will run the code of these third-party plugins at the next restart:
plugin_manager.enable_external.submit: I trust this code, enable it
plugin_manager.enable_external.title: Run the code of {name}?
plugin_manager.external.intro: Plugins are loaded when the wiki starts. Enabling one takes effect after a restart; disabling one closes its pages at once and removes its code at the next restart.
plugin_manager.external.title: Third-party plugins
plugin_manager.features.title: Built-in features
plugin_manager.field.file_hint: A ZIP archive of at most {size} MB. Nothing in it runs until you enable the plugin and restart.
plugin_manager.filter.label: Find a feature
plugin_manager.flash.backup_failed: The database could not be copied, so the plugin was not enabled.
plugin_manager.flash.backup_failed_drop: The database could not be copied first, so nothing was deleted.
plugin_manager.flash.builtin_not_removab: Built-in features cannot be removed; disable them instead.
plugin_manager.flash.dependency_unavaila: A required plugin cannot be enabled: {id}
plugin_manager.flash.enabled_missing: Enabled without: {deps}. Some of its functions may not work.
plugin_manager.flash.enabled_restart: {name} is enabled and will load at the next restart.
plugin_manager.flash.imported: {name} is installed and disabled. Review it, then enable it.
plugin_manager.flash.restarting: The wiki is restarting. Reload the page in a few seconds.
plugin_manager.intro: Turn optional features on or off. Your data and settings are kept.
plugin_manager.invalid.title: Folders that could not be read
plugin_manager.kit_hint: The authoring guide and an example plugin.
plugin_manager.lock.denylisted: Not available on this hosting plan
plugin_manager.lock.easy_wiki: Not available in Easy Wiki mode
plugin_manager.lock.external_off: Third-party plugins are turned off on this wiki (BW_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_PLUGINS=0). Built-in features can still be used.
plugin_manager.lock.external_off_managed: Custom plugins are not available on managed hosting unless the wiki runs in its own container.
plugin_manager.lock.retired: Retired: this plugin no longer exists
plugin_manager.order.empty: No feature adds an app to the sidebar.
plugin_manager.order.intro: Drag the apps, or use the arrow buttons, to choose their order in the sidebar.
plugin_manager.order.title: Sidebar apps
plugin_manager.restart.gunicorn: The wiki can restart its workers now.
plugin_manager.restart.manual: Restart the wiki with your process manager (for example: banana restart, or systemctl restart bananawiki).
plugin_manager.restart.preloaded: The server loads the application once in its main process, so its workers cannot pick up plugins on their own. Restart the service (for example: banana restart, or systemctl restart bananawiki).
plugin_manager.restart.title: A restart is needed to finish plugin changes
plugin_manager.retired.intro: These plugins from an earlier version no longer exist. They are inert: nothing loads and their data stays in the database. Remove the rows to tidy the list.
plugin_manager.retired.title: Retired plugins
plugin_manager.title: Plugins and features
plugin_manager.warning.admins: Any administrator can install plugins, so give the administrator role only to people you would trust with everything.
plugin_manager.warning.body: A plugin runs inside the wiki as the wiki itself. Once enabled it can read and change all data, read the secret key and act as any user, the owner included. Install only code you have reviewed and trust.
plugin_manager.warning.title: Plugins run with full privileges.
plugin_manager.zip.absolute_path: The archive contains an absolute file path.
plugin_manager.zip.bad_path: The archive contains an invalid file name.
plugin_manager.zip.compiled: Compiled code cannot be reviewed and is not accepted: {name}
plugin_manager.zip.duplicate: The archive contains the same file twice.
plugin_manager.zip.file_too_large: A file in the archive is larger than {limit} MB.

plugin_manager.zip.link: Links and special files are not allowed in plugins.
plugin_manager.zip.manifest_count: The archive must contain exactly one plugin.json, at its root or in one top-level folder.
plugin_manager.zip.not_zip: The file is not a valid plugin archive or is too large.

plugin_manager.zip.ratio: The archive is compressed suspiciously well and was refused.
plugin_manager.zip.too_large: The unpacked plugin would be larger than {limit} MB.
plugin_manager.zip.too_many_files: The archive has more than {limit} entries.
plugin_manager.zip.traversal: The archive contains a path that leaves its folder.
plugins.error.api_version: The plugin needs plugin API {version}, which this wiki does not provide.
plugins.error.blueprint_clash: The plugin's blueprint name {name} is already used.

plugins.error.manifest_not_object: plugin.json must contain a JSON object.
plugins.error.manifest_requires: The plugin.json field {field} must be a short list of plugin identifiers.
plugins.error.needs_newer: The plugin needs BananaWiki {version} or newer; this is {current}.
plugins.error.no_feature: The plugin defines neither FEATURE nor a 1.4 plugin object.
